newFindings.fact: Installed copied ReasoningRoot defaultOpen=false still opens automatically while streaming: userOpen ?? (streaming || initialOpen). Thread group-reasoning passes streaming=running. Merely mapping a Codex reasoning channel to an official reasoning part would therefore auto-expand it until the user toggles or streaming ends.
newFindings.classification: Forward integration behavior conflict with recorded default-collapsed requirement, not a reproduced current Codex UI bug. Current Web mapper still emits text for every segment.
newFindings.proposal: Use existing Thread ReasoningGroup injection / existing Reasoning primitives with controlled open/onOpenChange initialized collapsed. Preserve streaming indicator without granting streaming control over disclosure. Do not globally rewrite the vendor primitive or replace Thread.

newFindings.fact: Installed @assistant-ui/react 0.15.23 reexports @assistant-ui/core 0.3.22 ThreadMessageLike. ReasoningMessagePart has type reasoning, text, optional status, unstable_summary, providerMetadata and parentId. Both public reasoning-summary and reasoning-text fit supported reasoning parts, while source/channel remain separate identity metadata.
newFindings.proposal: Do not depend on unstable_summary or concatenate independent published channels without a product requirement. Keep their existing stream IDs/source/channel; render supported reasoning parts and label published summary vs published text when needed. Never request unpublished provider reasoning.

newFindings.fact: reasoning.aui.tsx marks its exported legacy ReasoningGroup wrapper deprecated for old MessagePrimitive.Parts. Current Thread uses MessagePrimitive.GroupedParts and its own components.ReasoningGroup receives group/children.
newFindings.proposal: Implement the current Thread injection shape if needed; do not copy the deprecated startIndex/endIndex wrapper as a new consumer API. Use existing stable message identity and per-pane lifecycle so another conversation or split pane does not inherit disclosure state.

boundedAcceptanceForExistingFollowup: Cold reasoning stream stays collapsed in each visible pane; answer text remains visible, and streaming status remains understandable.
Explicit expand/collapse through keyboard persists during later patches; changing streaming phase does not override manual choice or move composer focus.
Same turn in two panes has independent disclosure state, and switching center/generation does not carry state into unrelated messages.
Explicit settlement replaces only replaceStreamIds; retained reasoning and answer blocks keep correct IDs and source/channel, with no duplicate canonical reply or guessed last-block removal.
Existing official runtime reconciliation still removes evicted messages and preserves composer draft, stable user message object and disabled phantom branches.
Use existing cached public stream content; no eager detail request. Distinguish a collapsed presentation of already authorized patches from a promise that their bytes were never fetched.
Double-theme narrow-screen, keyboard and reduced-motion checks on the final integrated consumer; this source-only research is not visual or browser acceptance.

skills.method: Reused previously read local find-skills, assistant-ui, codebase-design and clean-code; inspected installed package source and fixed repository blobs; no installation.
